summary_en: Dividend per share increased by ¥2.00 from prior guidance (¥25.00 to ¥27.00 ordinary). Additional ¥3.00 commemorative dividend marking 30th anniversary of listing (Feb 2026), bringing total to ¥30.00/share. Total dividend ¥252M. Effective 2026-08-28. Subject to approval at Aug 27 AGM.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend distribution (dividend increase and commemorative dividend)
translation_en_brief: OZU Corporation's board resolved on 2026-07-10 to pay a dividend of ¥30.00 per share for the fiscal year ending 2026-05-31 (record date), comprising two elements: (1) ordinary dividend of ¥27.00 per share, an increase of ¥2.00 from prior guidance of ¥25.00, and (2) commemorative dividend of ¥3.00 per share to mark the company's 30th anniversary of listing (achieved 2026-02-23). Total dividend amount is ¥252 million. The ex-dividend effective date is 2026-08-28. The board cited comprehensive consideration of financial condition, balance-sheet strengthening, and internal reserves, combined with the milestone occasion. The dividend is subject to approval at the 115th ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for 2026-08-27. No share count or outstanding share data was disclosed in the filing, preventing computation of payout ratio or percentage of shares outstanding.
